notes.note: Reviewed composed account-sharing and member-passkey bootstrap after main2a1. Both preview declarations/binds remain; account loading stays inside the Settings rollback-aware loadProjectSharing owner, and its actual loadLocalAccounts call receives the live member-passkey selector. A new real StationRuntime.initialize cold-boot test exercises the stored sharing choice, public provider descriptor and real passkey options before/after preview changes. Existing origin, authority, privacy and separate efficiency grants remain unchanged. No new wire API or physical/native/two-human acceptance is claimed.
